product_name: Bajaj Life Insurance Family Protect Rider - Parental Care
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-linked, Non-participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider
variants: Parental Care (the option covered by this leaflet); Child Care is another option of the same rider
key_benefits: Rider benefit triggers on the earliest occurrence of Death or Accidental Total Permanent Disability (ATPD) of the rider Life Assured (who is the base-policy Life Assured)

Parental Care: on trigger, a lump sum equal to 105% of total rider premiums paid till date is paid immediately, PLUS a monthly income (0.1%-0.5% of Rider Sum Assured, chosen at inception) paid to the surviving parent(s) for the rest of their life
Health Management Services (medical second opinion, case management, consultation) at no additional cost while the rider is in force
Rider premium collected over and above the base policy premium

eligibility.policy_term: Rider Policy Term and Rider PPT must align with the base policy term and base PPT; numeric range not captured in this leaflet
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Aligned to base policy; single / limited / regular per base; numeric range not captured
eligibility.note: This is a RIDER attachable to a base policy (illustration uses Bajaj Life Insurance eTouch II). Eligibility boundary table not recovered; female lives get a 3-year age set-back. Note this leaflet uses the legacy 'Bajaj Life Insurance' branding.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the Rider Document; refund of rider premiums (excluding taxes) subject to proportionate risk premium, expenses and stamp duty; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.suicide_clause: On death of the base-policy Life Assured due to suicide within 12 months from commencement of risk or revival of the rider, nominee is entitled to at least 80% of total rider premiums paid till date (or the termination value if higher), provided the rider is in force.
key_terms.loan_note: Loan facility is NOT available in this rider.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per applicable tax laws as amended — consult a tax advisor. GST/cess collected over and above the premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Statement that this leaflet gives salient features of the Parental Care option only

claims_marketing_must_support: Rider benefit triggers ONLY on Death or ATPD of the rider Life Assured (the base-policy Life Assured) — not on the parents' death; if the parents predecease the trigger, no benefit is payable.
The lifelong monthly income is a percentage (0.1%-0.5%) of Rider Sum Assured chosen at inception, paid to the surviving parent(s) — must not be overstated.
Benefit amount '105% of total rider premiums paid' is the lump-sum portion, not an investment return.
This leaflet describes the Parental Care option specifically; the Child Care option has different terms.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market this as a standalone product — it is a rider that MUST reference and be attached to an eligible base policy.
Do NOT position as an investment, savings or maturity/money-back product — it is non-linked, non-participating pure-risk cover with no maturity benefit and no loan.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns' / 'bonus' language — there are no bonuses (non-par) and no returns.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'subject to applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Rider UIN 116B056V01 and reference to the base policy it is attached to
Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-linked, Non-participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider'
That the rider gives salient features only and must be read with the base plan and rider policy document
